paragraphs: Ulla Bira'ah—Rashi: of Biri—asked Abaye. R. Elazar said, Mo’ed Katan 26a (Megalleḥin). R. Ḥelbo said: Ulla Bira'ah said: R. Elazar said, Mo'ed Katan 26a and at the end of Ta’anit (31a). Ulla Berai: R. Elazar in R. Ḥanina's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Megalleḥin, halakhah 7; R. Berekhya, R. Ḥelbo, there. R. Ḥelbo in his name, Megillah 4a. In R. Shimon's name, Vayikra Rabbah 13.
